content:
It is with immense sadness and sorrow that we announce the passing of our colleague and friend Eng. Paulo Fonseca, Executive Director of BUILT CoLAB, and certainly a friend to many of you.

He passed away on Saturday night, apparently of a sudden heart attack.

This news comes as a surprise to everyone and causes enormous distress.

Our sincere condolences to his family and friends, on behalf of all the Governing Bodies and the entire BUILT CoLAB team.

Information on the funeral ceremonies for Eng. Paulo Fonseca.

The tribute and funeral ceremonies are planned in the following order:
. Today, the 2nd, from 8pm, wake with the body present at the Igreja da Lapa in Porto;
. Tomorrow, the 3rd, at 4:00pm, funeral ceremony at the Igreja da Lapa in Porto;
. Thursday, the 4th, at 7pm, funeral ceremony at the Igreja do Cartaxo.

As many will certainly know, Paulo was a man devoted to causes and to helping others. For this reason, the family asks that, should you wish, instead of the customary flowers as a final tribute, you make a small donation, which can be handed in at the venue of the ceremony, so that it may then be given, as he would have wished, to two social solidarity institutions he regularly supported.
